name: kanwich
description: Kanwich — an offline-first, local-only Kanban board.

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c blue,yellow "vite" "npm run electron:build:main && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env KANWICH_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron build/electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:pack:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:pack:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --linux
